title: Nutella Tunisian Wrap
description: A sweet and satisfying treat featuring Nutella, quenched, and tunisian in a crispy wrap.
instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
Place the wrap in the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Flip the wrap and spread 1 tbsp of Nutella on half of the wrap.
Add the tunisian and quenched on top of the Nutella.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the wrap is crispy.
Dust with powdered sugar if desired.
